summary: Product-scoped record for HTX flexible and fixed-term Simple Earn products. First-party terms published in January 2021 govern HTX Earn purchases, while 2026 first-party promotions confirm continuing flexible and fixed-term operation.
what_happened: HTX's Simple Earn Agreement, published on 25 January 2021 and updated in March 2025, applies to flexible and fixed-term Earn products. The agreement states that flexible subscriptions are matched with borrowing demand arising from HTX services and that flexible rates fluctuate with market conditions. Current first-party promotions in 2026 continue to advertise Flexible and fixed-term HTX Earn products. The reviewed sources do not establish the original launch date of the product family, so CYA leaves launch_date unresolved rather than treating the agreement publication date as launch.
uncertainty_notes: The 2021-01-25 date is the verified publication date of the Simple Earn Agreement, not a verified original launch date. HTX Earn also contains product families outside flexible/fixed Simple Earn, which are excluded from this product identity.
notes: Promotional principal-return mechanics describe product redemption behavior and are not converted into a universal legal, custody or solvency guarantee.

summary: Product-scoped record for CoinEx Flexible Savings and its Financial Account predecessor. First-party materials still used Financial Account on 30 July 2025 and documented Flexible Savings from 31 July 2025 onward; the product remains active in 2026.
what_happened: CoinEx operated a flexible interest product under the Financial Account name and documented that product on 30 July 2025 as allocating margin-borrowing interest to users. A Flexible Savings help page was published on 31 July 2025, and an August 2025 product-upgrade announcement used the Flexible Savings name. Current product materials link yields to Margin Trading and Loans borrowing rates plus CoinEx subsidies and warn that redemptions can be delayed if idle Flexible Savings assets are insufficient until borrowers return coins. The exact original Financial Account launch date and formal rename date remain unresolved, so neither is invented.
uncertainty_notes: Reviewed first-party materials establish product continuity across the Financial Account and Flexible Savings naming period but do not establish the exact formal rename date or original predecessor launch date.
notes: Marketing descriptions such as low-risk or principal-protected are retained as company characterizations and do not establish a universal custody, title or solvency guarantee.
